records.answer: The TatarTTS dataset contains around 70 hours of speech [1], and it was recorded by two professional speakers, one male and one female [2]. The duration for the male speaker is 36.2 hours and for the female speaker is 33.9 hours [4].
The apertium-anaphora module led to an increase in accuracy of anaphor translation for Spanish–English [2], but resulted in a slight decrease in accuracy for Catalan–Italian [1].

The apertium-recursive module was developed to deal with the limitations of finite-state chunking and to apply structural transfer rules recursively using context-free grammars (CFGs) and a Generalized Left-right Right-reduce (GLR) parser [2]. It works by processing nested structures such as relative clauses or prepositional phrases within prepositional phrases, reversing the word order of nested prepositional phrases (or the order of noun phrases (NPs) and adpositional phrases (PPs)) regardless of the number of prepositional phrases involved in order to translate from English to Basque [2].

The three golden rules of fat loss in Gutless are: 1) Calories, 2) Protein, and 3) Consistency [1]. These rules focus on the amount of energy (calories) you consume, the importance of protein, and the necessity of consistency in following the diet [4].
Using the simple method, a 185-pound person should eat between 1850 and 2220 calories per day to lose fat [1].

The evaluation showed that the models were assessed using the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) metric, which is widely used within the TTS domain [4]. A survey was conducted with native speakers to gauge the models' performance based on different criteria [4]. A set of 200 utterances narrated by speakers was randomly selected and formed the testing set, which was excluded from the model training process [4]. The TTS models were used to generate voice outputs for these utterances, providing both machine-generated and human narrations for comparative analysis [4]. A Telegram bot was developed to facilitate the assessment of 30 recordings per session, focusing on qualitative criteria such as audio quality, pronunciation, naturalness, and overall comprehensibility [4]. Participants were requested to rate each criterion on a scale from 1 (bad) to 5 (excellent) [4]. They were allowed to listen to the recordings multiple times but were restricted to submitting a single grade for each criterion [4]. The user interface of the bot was in Russian, influenced by the prevalent Tatar-Russian bilingualism observed within the target audience [4].

records.answer: To calculate your calorie intake for fat loss using the simple method, first convert your weight from kilograms to pounds. Since 1 kg is approximately 2.20462 pounds, 80 kg is approximately 176.37 pounds [1]. Then, multiply your weight in pounds by a number between 10 and 12. Your estimated calorie intake for fat loss would be somewhere between 1763.7 calories (176.37 x 10 = 1763.7) and 2116.44 calories (176.37 x 12 = 2116.44) per day [1].
100 grams of Quorn provides around 15 grams of protein [1], while the same amount of beef mince provides around 20 grams of protein [1].

Apertium uses weights to choose between conflicting structural transfer rules by applying different rules in different overlapping lexical environments [1]. These weights can be learned using an unsupervised maximum entropy approach [1].

Gutless says the timing of a water preload should depend on your age because the rate at which water leaves your stomach differs with age [2]. Younger individuals (in their 20’s or 30’s) have faster gastric emptying, so a water preload ingested 30 minutes before a meal is likely to be emptied by the time of the meal, making it less effective [2]. In contrast, older individuals (in their 40’s, 50’s, or beyond) have slower gastric emptying, so a water preload consumed anywhere between 30 minutes and immediately before a meal is more effective [2].

records.answer: The baseline TatarTTS models were built using the TatarTTS corpus, which consists of 70 hours of transcribed speech from two speakers [1]. The models were created as a baseline for the Tatar language [1]. Although they have some limitations, they demonstrate notable naturalness and sound quality [1]. The dataset, training recipe, and pre-trained TTS models are publicly available [3]. Separate TTS models were trained for each speaker, using A100 GPUs on an NVIDIA DGX server [4]. The text files were transformed to include only 39 Cyrillic letters and five specific symbols to ensure consistency and compatibility [4].

They are used as an example to demonstrate how lower energy density foods can help you eat less without feeling hungry [2]. In the author's own diet, frozen grapes are used as a dessert alternative that satisfies the sweet tooth without causing excessive calorie intake [3]. They also provide phytochemicals that contribute to the author's health [3].
